name: the SYMBOL spelling leaves the key set, so an ADR-0011 function carrying one extra argument renders differently and is simply not in the forbidden set (r5 L2)
expect: forbidden catches the ADR-0011 function with an ADDED ARGUMENT (r5 L2)

name: the bare trigger-name spelling leaves the key set, so an ADR-0011 trigger moved to a DIFFERENT TABLE is no longer forbidden (r5 L2)
expect: forbidden catches the ADR-0011 trigger on a DIFFERENT TABLE (r5 L2)

name: forbidden compares the WHOLE rendered name@digest instead of the key set — the digest-bearing comparison this file's own docstring says would silently never match
edits: return {o for o in live if _keys(o) & FORBIDDEN_KEYS}
return {o for o in live if o in FORBIDDEN_KEYS}
expect: forbidden matches by NAME, ignoring the digest

name: absent-mode goes back to matching name@digest, so every DRIFTED survivor is invisible — a hot-fixed or one-parameter-drifted M4 function stays live on a database this gate certifies as M4-free (r5 B1, MEASURED after a real rollback)
expect: absent FAILS when an M4 object survives and it drifted by one DEFAULTED PARAMETER, so `drop function` was a silent no-op

name: the ADR-0011 short-circuit is dropped, so a half-applied Task 1 passes as a valid M4 in PRESENT mode
expect: PRESENT also FAILS on an ADR-0011 object — a half-applied Task 1 is not a valid M4

name: present mode reverts to the bare SUBSET test, so a REMOVED object is caught and an ADDED one passes silently — backlog 65, on the only gate that can see production
edits: return manifest <= live and not unexpected(live, manifest, accepted)
expect: drift fails even when EVERY manifest object is present (subset holds)

name: `idx` leaves ATTRIBUTABLE_KINDS, so an index can no longer be attributed to a relation and every idx: entry is SKIPPED — measured 2026-08-28, `create unique index rev_uq on video_artifacts (video_id)` PASSED
expect: present FAILS on an UNEXPECTED INDEX on a relation M4 owns

name: the ownership test is dropped, so nothing is ever reported as drift and the additions half of the gate is inert
edits: if rest.split(".", 1)[0] in owned and n not in known:
expect: present FAILS on an UNEXPECTED COLUMN on a relation M4 owns

name: the accepted-additions allow-list stops being consulted, so a reviewed, deliberately-accepted later migration turns the gate permanently red with no exit
edits: known = {name_of(o) for o in manifest} | (accepted or set())
expect: an ACCEPTED addition is not drift

name: VIEWS leave the owned namespace, so drift on any M4 view is unattributable and therefore skipped
expect: owned_relations DERIVES the M4 namespace from table:/view: entries

name: missing and REDEFINED swap, so an object that is right there but inert is reported as missing and sends the reader hunting for a migration that did run
edits: missing = {o for o in manifest - live if name_of(o) not in live_names}
missing = {o for o in manifest - live if name_of(o) in live_names}
expect: a genuinely NEVER-CREATED object is reported as missing, not redefined

name: absent-mode residue reports MANIFEST lines instead of the live objects, so the failure names the line it failed to match rather than the thing still in the database
edits: return survivors(live, manifest) if mode == "absent" else (manifest - live)
expect: …and residue names the LIVE object, not the manifest line — it drifted by one DEFAULTE
